gmp-incheon-city-ikikata.desc: Gimpo Airport to your hotel door in central Incheon in one vehicle. Price by quote. Road distance 27.1km, about 29 min by car.
gmp-incheon-city-ikikata.h1: How to Get from Gimpo Airport to Central Incheon｜Direct to Your Hotel Door
gmp-incheon-city-ikikata.lead: A Kuma Travel transfer takes you from Gimpo Airport to central Incheon without changing vehicles. We meet you at Gimpo Airport and take you to your hotel door in central Incheon. The price is by quote.
box: Staria, up to 6 people, 4-5 large suitcases
secs: Direct from Gimpo Airport to Central Incheon
Booking：Send your date, flight number and hotel name in central Incheon via LINE, phone or email. We communicate in Japanese and Korean.
Meeting you：We wait at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor of the International Terminal with a board showing your name.
Drive：We load your luggage and head to central Incheon. From the International Terminal it is 27.1km, about 29 min without traffic.
Price：Quote on request. The road from the airport varies by destination in central Incheon, so tell us where you are going and we will take the shortest route.
Who Chooses Us

Late arrivals：We take you directly from the arrivals hall to your hotel in central Incheon, so you can rest as soon as you get there. The port district winds down early, and streets are quiet late at night.
2+ with luggage：Your driver helps carry your suitcases to the vehicle.
Kids and elders：We can provide a child seat free of charge. You stay in one vehicle all the way to your hotel door in central Incheon.
Solo travelers：A Genesis VIP transfer is also available. Contact us for the price.
Estimated Hotel Arrival by Flight Time
9:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in central Incheon around 10:40
13:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in central Incheon around 14:40
17:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in central Incheon around 18:40
21:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in central Incheon around 22:30
23:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in central Incheon around 0:30
Estimates allow about 50 min for immigration and baggage claim, with daytime road time multiplied by 1.4 for traffic.
About the Central Incheon Area

A port district with Chinatown in front of Incheon Station, Wolmido and the Bupyeong underground shopping area. Main sights include Incheon Chinatown, Wolmido and Bupyeong Underground Market. Nearby areas are Songdo (about 9.5km), Unseo (about 11.0km) and Paradise City (about 15.0km).
On arrival day：Enjoy jajangmyeon in Chinatown or a seaside walk on Wolmido.
flow: Arrival
We wait at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor of the International Terminal with a board showing your name.
Drive
We load your luggage and head to your hotel in central Incheon. From the International Terminal it is 27.1km, about 29 min without traffic.
Hotel
We drop you off at the front door. Enjoy jajangmyeon in Chinatown or a seaside walk on Wolmido.
faq: Do you offer Japanese support?
Yes. From booking through day-of contact, we communicate on LINE in Japanese and Korean. Your driver also speaks simple Japanese.
What happens if my flight is delayed?
We track your flight's arrival time and wait for you. There is no extra charge for delays.
How can I pay?
You can pay on the day in cash (won or yen) or by credit card.
Is there a cancellation fee?
Cancellation is free up to the day before. Same-day cancellation costs 50% of the price.

gmp-yeongdeungpo-ikikata.h1: How to Get from Gimpo Airport to Yeongdeungpo｜Easy Travel with a Fixed-Price Transfer
gmp-yeongdeungpo-ikikata.lead: Heading to Times Square or Yeongdeungpo Station? Leave your luggage at the hotel and travel light. This guide covers the steps and travel time for a transfer from Gimpo Airport to Yeongdeungpo.
box: KRW 80,000 (per vehicle, fixed price), same rate late at night and early morning
Staria, up to 6 people, 4-5 large suitcases
secs: Direct from Gimpo Airport to Yeongdeungpo
Booking：Send your date, flight number and hotel name in Yeongdeungpo via LINE, phone or email. We communicate in Japanese and Korean.
Meeting you：We wait at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor of the International Terminal with a board showing your name.
Drive：We load your luggage and head to Yeongdeungpo. From the International Terminal it is 13.7km, about 18 min without traffic.
Price：KRW 80,000 fixed price (per vehicle). Streets around Yeongdeungpo Station are a maze, so please tell us your hotel name and address in advance.
When a Transfer Helps Most
Late arrivals：We take you directly from the arrivals hall to your hotel in Yeongdeungpo, so you can rest as soon as you get there. The station area stays busy at night.
2+ with luggage：KRW 20,000 per person for 4. Your driver helps carry your suitcases to the vehicle.
Wheelchair use：Available at no extra charge. Your driver helps with loading and with getting in and out.
Solo travelers：A Genesis VIP transfer is also available. Contact us for the price.
Estimated Hotel Arrival by Flight Time

From Gimpo Airport, we leave on the east side of the airport and head to Yeongdeungpo on roads such as Olympic-daero (south of the Han River). Much of the route avoids expressways, so waiting at traffic lights affects the travel time.
9:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in Yeongdeungpo around 10:20
13:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in Yeongdeungpo around 14:20
17:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in Yeongdeungpo around 18:20
21:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in Yeongdeungpo around 22:10
23:00 arrival：Reach your hotel in Yeongdeungpo around 0:10

About the Yeongdeungpo Area

A commercial area around Times Square and Yeongdeungpo Station. It is also a good base for the Guro Digital Complex. Main sights include Times Square, Yeongdeungpo Station and Yeouido. Nearby areas are Yeouido (about 1.6km), Hongdae (about 4.8km) and Yongsan (about 5.3km).
On arrival day：Times Square has shopping and dining, and Yeouido is close by.
